newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag to invest blns of marks in next 5 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Viag to invest blns of marks in next 5 yrs.

text.p: German utility group Viag AG expects its investments over the next five years to amount to several billion marks, its management board chairman Georg Obermeier said.
Obermeier told jornalists late Wednesday evening that at least two billion marks would be spent on acquisitions and co-operations as well as the "usual" investments.
He added that the scale of spending would depend on the projects undertaken and the opportunities for worthwhile acquisitions.
